A '''slopewing''' was a creature that was used in the herding of such creatures as [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]] and [[nauga]]s. The slopewing could be found on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] rode one in [[farm school]].
